responsibility: This header declares the word-list abstraction used in the mc-boot runtime. It defines the opaque wlists_wlist handle and callback type for visiting unsigned integer elements, and exports the operations for creating, destroying, appending, indexing, counting, searching, duplicate-filtered inclusion, removal, replacement, membership testing, traversal, and duplication of lists of WORD/CARDINAL values.
same_name_distinction: Declares the opaque wlist type, callback signature, and exported operations for word lists, whereas Gwlists.cc provides the concrete linked-block structure and list-manipulation implementation.
